Streaming chat completion via the Google Vertex AI provider using the vertex_ai/ prefix — verifies SSE chunks from the Gemini streaming endpoint are yielded and assembled correctly

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Liter\Llm\LiterLlm;
use Liter\Llm\ChatCompletionRequest;
$req = \Liter\Llm\ChatCompletionRequest::from_json(json_encode(["maxTokens" => 32, "messages" => [["content" => "Count to three, one word per response.", "role" => "user"]], "model" => "vertex_ai/gemini-2.0-flash", "stream" => true]));
$chunks = iterator_to_array(LiterLlm::chatStream($req));
```
